annotations.title: weatherpeek: get an hourly weather forecast for a place or coordinates

description: weatherpeek: hourly weather forecast for a point or a city. For airport observations use get_metar. Input: either `lat` and `lon` together, or `place` alone, plus optional `hours`. `place` matches cities of 15,000+ people offline ("City" or "City, CC" with an ISO country code); no match is a 404 place_not_found (not charged). Upstream errors are a 5xx and are not charged. Typically 0.1-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 5 weather forecasts per IP per UTC day. Data: MET Norway and GeoNames, both CC BY 4.0; credit them when you show or republish it (see `attribution`). Forecasts are numerical weather model output and can be wrong: not for safety-critical decisions (aviation, marine, severe-weather warnings); use official services for those. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/weather-api-no-key.html

lat.description: Latitude (-90..90); give lat and lon together, or place.
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: Longitude (-180..180); give lat and lon together, or place.
lon.title: Lon

place.description: City name, optionally "City, CC" with an ISO country code (cities with 15,000+ people); give place alone, or lat and lon.
place.title: Place
